options.name: 01 · La firma
options.description: Pastel coral con piping marfil: la identidad de Cakes by Yas convertida en protagonista.
options.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: photographic bakery homepage hero, one landscape 16:9 image, highest available native photographic detail.
Create a distinctive premium contemporary birthday-cake campaign photograph for Cakes by Yas. Brand palette: warm ivory #FAF5EE, coral pink #EA677D, pale rose #F8A8B1; dark warm ink text will be added separately in HTML. The image must feel joyful, confident, tactile and personally made, with refined editorial art direction.
Subject: a beautiful ONE-TIER round birthday cake, actual edible handmade coral pink buttercream, smooth hand-spatula finish retaining minute natural imperfections. Confident generous ivory piped shell border around the top and base, and only three large expressive ivory buttercream swirls arranged asymmetrically on top, their soft looping curves gently echo a flowing Y-shaped cream mark without literally drawing letters. Two very slender ivory birthday candles of different heights, naturally placed. No inscriptions or cake toppers. This should be a plausible elegant signature cake, not a fantasy sculpture.
Set: simple warm ivory seamless tabletop and wall, cake on a thin ivory round cake board. No pedestal, no crown, no gold, no ribbon, no flowers, no gift boxes. A natural soft side-cast cake shadow adds depth. Camera at cake middle height with a subtle elevated view of the top, 70mm professional food photograph. Large soft side daylight, controlled light, clean warm-neutral grading. Real buttercream, tiny piping ridges, lifelike candle wax, physical gravity, no plastic gloss.
Composition for a website: cake completely framed at RIGHT x75%, occupying 65% of frame height and around 37% frame width, comfortable space around candles and board. LEFT 53% is quiet, pale ivory negative space for very large dark lettering; top 12% also quiet for navigation. Don't add any typography, logo, graphic overlays or watermarks. Floor and background have the same warm ivory, no fake orange gradient. Slight film-like tonal texture, considered asymmetry, appetizing coral, no neon saturation or digital render look.
Single finished photograph, not a mockup, no border or collage.

options.name: 02 · El primer corte
options.description: El interior y la textura del pastel cuentan la celebración: una dirección más apetecible y cercana.
options.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: photographic bakery homepage hero, one landscape 16:9 image, highest available native photographic detail.
Create a warm, memorable high-end food editorial still life for Cakes by Yas, celebrating the first slice of a birthday cake. Brand colors ivory #FAF5EE, coral #EA677D, pale rose #F8A8B1, all natural and restrained.
Subject on RIGHT: a round ivory buttercream cake with a clean single wedge already removed, revealing airy moist golden vanilla crumb and two thin rich caramel dulce-de-leche layers. The cake is handmade and appetizing, not a perfect computer geometry. Fine coral pink hand-piped shell edging around the top, one small loose coral buttercream flourish; no flowers or toppers, no writing. On a small low ivory ceramic dessert plate in the foreground to the right, the removed slice stands naturally upright, with the same sponge and caramel layers in exact physical continuity. A few tiny real crumbs near that plate, no mess. Whole cake behind the slice in slightly softer focus, slice is the sensory focal point. Both on an ivory tabletop; no ribbons, no crowns, no gold embellishment, no utensils or hands.
Composition: editorial 16:9 crop, the cake and slice grouped in RIGHT 48% of frame. Whole cake approximately x77%, y43%; slice foreground x69%, y73%. Keep LEFT 52% completely quiet warm ivory for huge dark website headline and top 12% calm for navigation. Keep main cake and slice readable and physically plausible, no giant cake stand. Camera at a low three-quarter food-photo angle; natural 80mm optics, moderate depth of field, soft diffused window daylight from left and gentle shadow falloff.
Photographic realism: natural buttercream spatula texture, subtle real sponge pores, matte pastry, restrained caramel shine; genuine fine food photography. Cream not yellow, coral not neon, no stretched layers, no melting cake, no extra cuts or fake shiny CGI surfaces, no artificial bokeh blobs. No text, logos, lettering, graphic elements, watermark or collage. One finished campaign photograph only.

options.name: 03 · El gesto
options.description: Un macro de crema y piping coral que recoge las curvas del isotipo; más gráfico y editorial.
options.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: premium bakery campaign hero photograph, landscape 16:9, highest available native detail.
Create a distinctive macro food photograph that translates Cakes by Yas's flowing cream/Y identity into REAL EDIBLE BUTTERCREAM and curves. Palette warm ivory #FAF5EE, coral pink #EA677D, pale rose #F8A8B1. The left side must remain calm enough for dark large HTML text.
Composition: on the RIGHT HALF of frame, an intimate, extremely tactile close-up of the upper rounded rim and side of an ivory handmade birthday cake. Cake occupies the rightmost 45% and continues out of the lower-right frame. Its top bears THREE generously scaled coral-pink hand-piped buttercream rosettes in a fluid, elegant asymmetric sweep; beautiful grooved piping curls that suggest the energy of a flowing cream mark, without forming a literal letter or logo. Each rosette is physically piped, organic, distinct and edible, not a flat pattern. A single slender ivory birthday candle rises subtly behind the last swirl near the upper right. No text or other decorations. Show a small amount of off-white cake side with a delicate spatula trace.
Strong editorial framing: close enough to see ridges and fine airy buttercream texture; the nearest rosette is tack sharp, two behind gently soften, but not exaggerated synthetic bokeh. Camera at a low 3/4 angle looking across the cake top, 100mm macro food photography with controlled focus stacking. Large soft daylight from upper left, creamy highlights, gentle natural shadows inside piping; coral is muted warm pink, not plastic or neon.
LEFT 55%: uninterrupted warm ivory real background with subtle natural tonal falloff. Top-left and center-left quiet for navigation and a headline; no objects or dramatic shadows there. This is a luxurious tactile photographic gesture with deliberate scale, not a catalog view and not an abstract illustration.
Avoid geometric pedestals, ribbon, crown, gold, flowers, sprinkles, confetti, hands, kitchen tools, fake steam, shiny frosting, 3D render, impossible ridges, glossy clay or melted foam. No logos, words, watermark, graphic overlay or collage. Deliver one finished photograph only.
